description:
pattern     media-matrix / gallery
surface     dark
kit         signature above heading
form        Columns 1–12 provide the section heading, followed by an interactive category filter bar (All, Academic, Campus Life, Events, Hackathons), and a 12-item masonry photo gallery featuring smooth hover image zoom and full-screen lightbox modal inspection on click. On mobile, the masonry displays in 2 clean columns with swipe dismissal on modals.

image       mixed 4:5 and 16:9; collection of 12 documentary photographs covering library study sessions, auditorium ceremonies, hackathon whiteboard sessions, server rack wiring, project defenses, stage talks, campus sunsets, robotics labs, sports meets, community workshops, poster presentations, and graduation batch smiles; placed in masonry grid slots, treatment documentary; alt: Visual memories and documentary moments of Tharindu Perera at University of Vavuniya

plan check  heading placed; filter buttons by category placed; masonry gallery of 12 photos with hover zoom and lightbox on click placed.
layout_description: Full-width media gallery with centered top header, category filter pill bar, and three-column masonry image grid.
